name: ledger-dispatch-probe
title: Probe the dispatch_auto scheduler end-to-end for usage-ledger capture
description: A throwaway probe story used only as a scheduling target so dispatch_auto can launch one real claude-code worker and we can observe the usage ledger capturing the real provider-reported token record. No code is produced; the worker objective is a trivial no-op reply.

events.reason: Throwaway probe target for the dispatch_auto usage-ledger demonstration; dispatch completed and the ledger captured the real claude-code record. No code produced.
